rules.statement: In test scripts, don't ask for a small setup/restore block copied across standalone test suites to be moved into a shared dot-sourced helper when each suite is self-contained by convention and a test or CI check already requires every copy to match exactly.
rules.why: The suites are standalone scripts that define their own helpers. The exact-match check means the copies can't drift without failing CI, and a shared helper would give suites that have no dot-sourced dependency today a new one.
rules.check: Before reporting duplication across test scripts, see whether the sibling suites define their own helpers instead of dot-sourcing a shared file, and whether a runner or meta-test already matches the copied lines exactly. If both are true, don't raise the finding.
